rawContent: He didn’t and that matters. FYI, the person responsible for any possible damage to #MeToo is Tara Reade and no one else.

@Colombias I think they thought the Reade accusation was going to stick and it hasn’t. Boosting her story was a trap for us all. If it had gone to plan she’d have been discredited and they’d kneecap #metoo, but that hasn’t happened. So, now they’re trying to make an example of Farrow.
